geometry_edits.rationale: Rebuild the dominant mass as a stronger continuous bent body rather than a compact stacked extrusion.
Increase the bending angle to produce a more readable dominant gesture in all views.
Add section detail so the bend is continuous rather than abrupt.
Open a more substantial court/void to satisfy the active public ground requirement.
Orient the void toward the access side so the frontage reads as a public threshold instead of a sealed edge.
Lower the connecting terrace to better articulate the section and create a more usable ground-related seam.

graph_edits.rationale: Make the dominant mass more site-responsive and less like a generic stacked box by increasing the longitudinal bend and giving the body a clearer continuous gesture.
Strengthen the primary gesture so the silhouette reads as one continuous bent mass instead of a mostly rectilinear block.
Increase sectional resolution so the bend can express a calmer, more legible continuous curve in the mass.
Carve a clearer public void that can become the neighborhood court and activate the ground threshold.
Align the courtyard opening with the verified access side in the program frame so the public void responds to frontage.
Lower the terrace link to make the ground-to-upper transition more legible and reduce the sealed-box effect at street level.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact bent mass with a recognizable stepped/tilted roof, so it avoids total incoherence and has some relation to the reference language. However, across the four views it remains mostly a small stacked box with one dominant solid and only minor roof articulation; the gesture is weak and not strongly differentiated into a primary mass plus support. The blue road frontage/access edge is not answered by a legible public void, court, undercut, or entry seam; instead the ground condition stays largely sealed, so the required neighborhood-active threshold is missing. The top view suggests a parcel-respecting orientation, but the open-space figure is underdeveloped and the mass feels more like a generic extrusion than a program-responsive neighborhood living building. Program fit therefore fails: it can host the brief only in a very weak sense, because the visible mass does not clearly establish active ground edge + usable public void + calm upper hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More pavilion/cultural than neighborhood-living; reference is lighter and more explicitly courtyard-centered than this candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Clear central void with a composed upper bridge/connector and calm solid masses framing a public threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger multi-building complex; do not copy the tower-podium scale or aerial campus composition.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like courtyard organization with terraced low-rise blocks and readable hierarchy around open space.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Commercial/retail image with much stronger perimeter openness; candidate is too compact and too sealed at ground.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long horizontal mass with a carved central void and site-responsive curvature/folded roof logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Educational campus with more generous connective circulation; candidate lacks that section depth and continuity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, ribbon-like section that turns topography into a legible public sequence and open court.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office/gallery-like interlocking composition; candidate is not yet articulated enough to support the same spatial richness.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking wings, central void, and bridged circulation create a strong public interior threshold.

warnings: Parcel containment appears satisfied, but containment alone is not enough.
The form is coherent enough in plan/iso, but the access edge response is semantically wrong or absent.
Solids do not visibly collide across views, but the mass is still too box-like and too sealed at ground to pass program_fit_hard_pass.
